services.name: Walking Tours
services.desc: The Historical Society provides a series of educational programs that support the local history curriculum of our schools. Each school year in the fall and spring, local third grade classes are invited to experience early Walnut Creek ranch life in the Living History Program 1906 at Shadelands Ranch. During the one-day program, third graders relive a typical early 1900s day at Shadelands Ranch. With the help of docents who play characters who lived at the ranch in 1906, the students first tour the historic house and grounds, including the workers’ bunkhouse, the water tower, and basement.
